prior_source_research.name: Baratashvili Bride
prior_source_research.place_summary: 'Baratashvili Bride' is typo for Baratashvili Bridge, traffic/pedestrian bridge over Mtkvari river in Tbilisi. Source specifies lower-level pedestrian deck beneath/adjacent main bridge and has negative comments in Dec 2024 and June 2023 saying lighting, cameras and footfall have reduced or ended cruising. Those are historical not post-cutoff, and no recent first-person activity. Do not confuse with nearby Bridge of Peace 0.4km away.

verification_sources.notes: 2024-12-08 reviewer dismisses place as bright and crowded, 2023 says no longer cruising; 2020 positive history
Pedestrian/road bridge over Kura, built 1966; not activity evidence

p3_evidence.primary_access: FULL primary individual page read. Typo 'Bride' means Baratashvili BRIDGE. Source explicitly identifies lower pedestrian level (-1 deck) of bridge. Current Gays-Cruising listing remains visible but public recent comments end 2024.

p3_evidence.geography: Baratashvili Bridge crossing Kura/Mtkvari River, Tbilisi. Lower-level pedestrian deck was historically claimed sexual-cruising subsection; NOT the nearby Bridge of Peace/Rike Park (0.4km on source nearby list).

independent.finding: Distinct actual historical bridge in Tbilisi, not an operator verification of accessible lower level.

dated_reports.finding: Visitor describes men using darker corners of lower pedestrian level.
Commenter says bridge renovated and brighter, much general pedestrian activity and no cruising visible.
Commenter complains of lights, security cameras and crowds; recommends against as a cruising spot. Does not prove permanent closure.

p3_evidence.activity: Historically credible directory and positive firsthand (2020), subsequent negative/physical changes 2023–24, NO recent 2025-11 to 2026-11 positive activity. Preserve as historical/inactive-reported, not closed or deleted.

records.name: Gaash beach

prior_source_records.name: Gaash beach
prior_source_records.place_assessment: Ga'ash Beach is on the coast by Kibbutz Gaash/Hof HaSharon, southwest of Netanya, not within Netanya municipality despite archive city assignment. Independently documented gay-popular unofficial clothing-optional beach by official tourism and TravelGay, plus a CruisingGays directory 'Verified Oct 2026' against a current listing. That October update is directory verification, not a documented firsthand sexual encounter. Ga'ash cliffs can be unstable and nudity is not officially designated/legal. Strong independent site identity/gay reputation but insufficient 12-month firsthand report.

verification_sources.notes: Claims day activity and crowds, no dated comments
Gay-popular beach and unofficial naturist reputation
Ga'ash address, reputation, not sex confirmation
Verified Oct 2026 listing review but not firsthand visitor report
Outside Netanya bounds, cliffs safety and no official nudity

part3_deep.primary_read: FULL original page. Source categorizes Gaash Beach as naturist beach with claimed daytime male cruising, high inflow but low privacy (undated subjective). No comments and zero checkins in snapshot. Location listed as Netanya in directory but physically by Ga'ash/Yakum south of central Netanya.

records.name: Central Train Station

prior_source_records.name: Central Train Station
prior_source_records.place_summary: Tel Aviv 'Central Train Station' is the rail station now commonly called Savidor Merkaz, next to Arlozorov. Primary spot directory claims it as the most active outdoor gay cruising area but has only March 1 2025 contact-message comment (pre-cutoff). TravelGay states this cruising location no longer active from February 2017 because of construction. Crucial conflict: do not present source superlative high activity as true or equate with much farther southern New Central Bus Station. Precise outdoors area currently undefined.

verification_sources.notes: No longer active as of Feb 2017, under construction at original site
Other nearby 'New Central Station' 3.5km away supports distinct bus terminal

part3_deep.primary_read: FULL original Gays-Cruising page. Claims 'most active outdoor gay cruising' near Central Train Station, high influx, daylong, undated. One comment 2025-03-01 'text me for this place', not a visitor report. No 2026 reports on source page.

source_pin.provenance: Original Gays-Cruising Get Directions driving map, Savidor railway reference

part3_deep.site: Tel Aviv Savidor Center railway station, NOT Tel Aviv New Central Bus Station ~3.5km away.

independent.finding: Independent gay-travel directory explicitly states Savidor outdoor cruising ceased by February 2017 during construction. Treat as historical closure of sex meeting point, NOT closure of active rail station.
Rail station architect describes original 2017 renovation, updated entrance/yard/service building; some works completed 2019. Corroborates physical layout changed.
22 March 2026 railway line at Savidor resumed after March 18 damage, proving railway operational, not that the 2017 cruising area reopened.
Oct 2026 local urban development proposals refer to planned transit upgrades, not physical cruising or current total closure.

dated_reports.finding: TravelGay reports original outdoor place no longer active since Feb 2017, during construction.
Gays-Cruising commenter asks others to send a message, not evidence of an observed encounter.

part3_deep.activity: Historical gay meeting point is specifically reported obsolete since 2017; current railway still operates. Keep original evidence and distinguish status from permanent building shutdown.
